notes: CONFIRMED root cause for cycles 1115 and 1117; the signature is CONSISTENT WITH but UNPROVEN for 1107/1116, whose failing test names are unrecoverable (see acs-evidence-tail-capture — that is precisely why they cannot be confirmed) and whose predicates never ran ./internal/bridge at all; their actual trigger is core-suite-shared-tmp-p-hermeticity. Evidence: the tests that failed at audit time were TestZZAudit_QuoteSpillSuppressed (1115) and TestZZAuditProbe_BulletBannerSuppressed (1117) — the ZZ prefix sorts last; these are probe tests the AUDITOR authored into internal/bridge. A meta-predicate running `go test ./internal/bridge/...` inherits the probe's failure as if the BUILDER had regressed a sibling. Corroboration: each cycle's exact suite, re-run quietly in its preserved worktree, is EXIT=0 green (verified 2026-07-27), and the auditor's own verdict disagreed with the gate (see verdict-coherence-auditor-vs-egps). Caveat on the 1117 pair: red #1 used `-run ^TestC1117_`, which EXCLUDES TestZZAuditProbe_* by construction, so only red #2 (the unfiltered bridge+recovery sweep) is probe-explained. The safe pattern already exists in-tree: cycle-1106's auditor probed via `go test -overlay` (PoCA/PoCB), which never writes the real tree. FIX: (a) auditor persona MUST use -overlay for probes — note agents/evolve-auditor.md today contains ZERO mentions of overlay/probe/_test.go, so this is a NET-NEW rule, not a tightening; (b) Go backstop: detect untracked *_test.go created during the audit phase, PRESERVE them to the run dir (today discarded, so the finding is unrecoverable), exclude before the ACS run, log loudly.
